description: Na₂CoSiO₄ is beta beryllia-derived structured and crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pmn2₁ space group. Na is bonded to four O atoms to form NaO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent NaO₄ tetrahedra, corners with four equivalent CoO₄ tetrahedra, and corners with four equivalent SiO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.26-2.35 Å. Co is bonded to four O atoms to form CoO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent SiO₄ tetrahedra and corners with eight equivalent NaO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Co-O bond distances ranging from 1.96-2.05 Å. Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent CoO₄ tetrahedra and corners with eight equivalent NaO₄ tetrahedra. There are two shorter (1.65 Å) and two longer (1.67 Å) Si-O bond lengths. There are three inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two equivalent Na, one Co, and one Si atom. In the second O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na, one Co, and one Si atom to form distorted corner-sharing ONa₂CoSi tetrahedra. In the third O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na, one Co, and one Si atom to form distorted corner-sharing ONa₂CoSi tetrahedra.
